summary.en: The longer strips of a contact sheet pull out to their own lengths one after another, then the measured lengths are set at their ends.
summary.zh: 印样里较长的胶片依次拉长到各自的长度，然后在末端写出量出的时长。

fits: Showing that lengths differ and by how much.
notFor: Equal lengths; values that are not lengths.

intent.en: Let the differences grow in front of the viewer, then name them.
intent.zh: 让差异在观众眼前长出来，再写出数值。

content.en: The rows of a contact sheet with their durations.
content.zh: 印样的各行和它们的时长。

fits.zh: 要表现长度不同、差多少时。

notFor.zh: 长度都相同；不是长度的数值。
